definitions.explanation: A high level of skill achieved through extensive practice and training. Implies refined expertise developed over time.

examples.japanese: {練達|れんたつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{練達|れんたつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{通訳者|つうやくしゃ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: She is known as an accomplished interpreter.

examples.japanese: {練達|れんたつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧でなければ、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: Unless you're an expert physician, this surgery is difficult.

notes:
USAGE: {練達|れんたつ} emphasizes skill acquired through rigorous training and practice. Often used with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ to modify nouns ({練達|れんたつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧).

FORMALITY: Formal/literary. More common in written language than casual speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {練達|れんたつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{士|し}→〜士：28352_shi⟧/⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (master, expert)
- {練達|れんたつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧/⟦{腕前|うでまえ}→腕前：07299_udemae⟧ (mastered skill)
- {練達|れんたつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{極|きわ}める→極める：13139_kiwameru⟧ (to attain mastery)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{熟練|じゅくれん}→熟練：09081_jukuren⟧ (skilled - more commonly used)
- ⟦{熟達|じゅくたつ}→熟達：15463_jukutatsu⟧ (proficiency - similar meaning)
- ⟦{達人|たつじん}→達人：14378_tatsujin⟧ (master, expert - noun form)
